name: Gästehaus Radetzky
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Radetzky is situated in the community of Kössen in the Tyrolean Unterland. It is run as a traditional inn offering welcoming guest accommodations. The rooms are simply and practically furnished. Facilities include a cosy dining room serving local regional cuisine. The scenery around Kössen is defined by the peaks of the Kitzbühel Alps, making it a great starting point for hiking adventures and ski excursions. The atmosphere throughout the house is genuine, relaxed, and hospitable, making it an excellent base for travellers seeking straightforward lodging.
